description: Import a CAR file to create or restore a repository on this PDS. Admin only.

main.description: Import a full repository from a CAR stream. Used for migration and disaster recovery.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing DID parameter or invalid CAR data.

errors.name: RepoAlreadyExists
errors.description: A repository already exists for this DID.

errors.name: InvalidCar
errors.description: CAR data is malformed or cannot be parsed.

errors.name: DidMismatch
errors.description: The CAR's commit belongs to a different DID.

errors.name: PayloadTooLarge
errors.description: Request payload exceeds the accepted size limit.

errors.name: UnresolvableDid
errors.description: The DID's atproto signing key could not be resolved.

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.description: The commit is not signed by the DID's current atproto key.

errors.name: InvalidRepo
errors.description: The repository is incomplete or malformed (missing blocks, broken record tree).
